result:
If I could change one thing, I'd make it so humans couldn't lie to themselves.

No more motivated reasoning. No more believing convenient stories because they feel good or protect your identity. No more ignoring evidence that threatens your ego, your tribe, or your worldview. People would still disagree and fuck up, but the baseline would shift: reality would be harder to dodge.

Most of the world's biggest problems aren't pure malice or lack of resources. They're downstream of self-deception on a massive scale—about human nature, about trade-offs, about what actually works versus what feels righteous. Strip that away and a lot of the rest starts looking solvable instead of eternal.
